## Part 3 Visualization
```{r}
gt(spring_data)
```

ggplot2 is different from ggplot
ggplot is step 1 (tell which data frame to use)
then ggplot builds Figures by making blank plot and adds laeyers

```{r}
ggplot(spring_data)
```
back to previous practical stuff
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)

gt(my_data_frame)

ggplot(my_data_frame, aes(x = length, y = weight)) +
  geom_point()
```
